mechanism: Public HTTP GET to Humana's Medical and Pharmacy Coverage Policies search listing (ASP.NET WebForms GridView), no authentication required. Each row exposes a javascript:__doPostBack(...) link; POSTing the captured __VIEWSTATE/__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR with __EVENTTARGET/__EVENTARGUMENT for that row returns an HTTP 302 whose Location header is the real document URL on dctm.humana.com (Documentum).

date_range.note: Corrected after review: the original value here was computed by taking the first/last elements of the resolved-records list, which is grouped by source listing URL (pharmacy batch, then medical batch) rather than being a flat date sort, so it understated the true range. True min/max reviewed dates across all 93 resolved records, computed directly, are 8/19/2026 (oldest) and 9/3/2026 (newest).

limitations: Sort applied is by 'Reviewed Date' as extracted and re-sorted in Python; site's own sortfield=reviewdate query param did not appear to fully pre-sort the raw HTML output, so re-sorting client side on the real date string was necessary.

document_url/object_id/search_id are resolved live per request via session-bound postback; the exttoken embedded in each dctm.humana.com URL is short-lived/session-scoped and will not remain valid indefinitely.
Only 'medical' and 'pharmacy' policyType values were used (both discovered directly via real navigation links on the site's own home page, not guessed).

No PDF content was downloaded/parsed for these 100 records (only the listing metadata + resolved document URL) to keep the run fast and avoid unnecessary load on Humana's servers; humana_injections_pain_conditions.py demonstrates the working PDF-download step for a single target if full-text is later needed.

Because the top-100-by-reviewed-date selection landed almost entirely inside a large tie group of pharmacy policies all dated 8/19/2026, the resolved set is heavily skewed toward pharmacy (92 of 93) with only 1 medical policy; this is an honest artifact of Humana's real review-date distribution (a large pharmacy policy batch was apparently reviewed/republished on 8/19/2026), not a selection error. The medical listing's own newest reviewed dates (e.g. 8/28/2026, 8/11/2026) are older than that pharmacy batch.

7 of the 100 selected rows failed to resolve to a document URL (5 read-timeouts/DNS blips against mcp.humana.com, 1 incomplete-read on a large response, all transient network errors during a long sequential run) - not access-denied or auth failures. 93 of 100 (93%) resolved successfully.

93 resolved records represent 93 distinct document object_ids (all unique - verified) but only 71 distinct policy names, because Humana publishes multiple separate document rows under the same policy name (different line-of-business/product versions with different effective dates but the same reviewed date). Each row is a genuinely distinct real document, not a duplicate.
